description: MainActivity.java for an Android application that schedules and manages background jobs using the JobScheduler API. It provides UI controls to configure job parameters such as delay, deadline, network conditions, charging, idle state, and work duration. It also handles communication with a service via Messenger for status updates and visual feedback.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main Activity that allows scheduling, canceling, and finishing background jobs with configurable parameters, and handling messages from the job service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets up message handler.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the service and provides communication channel.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops the service when activity stops.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Creates and schedules a new job based on user input parameters.
